title: UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant 2026 - 2,759 Posts, Apply from May 22 at upsssc.gov.in
author: Ash K.
summary: UPSSSC has released notification for 2,759 Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) Group C posts. Online applications open May 22, last date June 11, 2026. B.Sc Agriculture graduates eligible. Requires UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard. Application fee just ₹25.
body: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released notification for 2,759 Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) Group C posts under Advt No. 06-Exam/2026.

DetailInformation
Total Posts2,759
Post NameAgriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) Group C
Apply StartMay 22, 2026
Last DateJune 11, 2026
Correction WindowUp to June 18, 2026
EligibilityB.Sc Agriculture / Horticulture / Forestry / B.Tech Agri Engg
PET RequiredYes - UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard mandatory
Age Limit21-40 years
Application Fee₹25 (all categories)
Pay ScaleLevel 4 (₹25,500-81,100)
SelectionWritten Exam (100 MCQs, 2 hrs) + DV
Negative Marking0.25 marks per wrong answer
Category-wise vacancies: UR - 1,107 | SC - 579 | ST - 55 | OBC - 745 | EWS - 273. Horizontal reservation as per UP government rules.

Eligibility: B.Sc in Agriculture, Horticulture, or Forestry, OR B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering from a recognized university. UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard is mandatory - candidates who haven't appeared for PET cannot apply.

Selection process: Written examination with 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks. Duration: 2 hours. Negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer. Followed by document verification for shortlisted candidates.
How to apply: Visit upsssc.gov.in → Click on 'Online Application' → Select AGTA Recruitment 2026 → Register → Fill form with PET Memo ID → Upload documents → Pay ₹25 fee → Submit.
Important: The correction window closes June 18, 2026. Double-check all details before the window expires. Exam date and admit card release will be notified separately on upsssc.gov.in.
For UP government job preparation, check our UPPSC PCS exam guide. For age relaxation details applicable to UP state exams, see our age relaxation rules guide.

faqs.question: When can I apply for UPSSSC AGTA 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on May 22, 2026 and close on June 11, 2026 at upsssc.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is UPSSSC PET required for AGTA 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard is mandatory. Candidates who haven't appeared for PET 2025 cannot apply for this recruitment.

faqs.question: What is the qualification for UPSSSC AGTA 2026?
faqs.answer: B.Sc in Agriculture, Horticulture, or Forestry, OR B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering from a recognized university.

faqs.question: What is the salary for UPSSSC Technical Assistant?
faqs.answer: Pay Level 4 with pay range of ₹25,500 to ₹81,100 per month plus DA, HRA, and other allowances.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in UPSSSC AGTA exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. The exam has 100 MCQs worth 100 marks with 2 hours duration.

callout.heading: PET Scorecard Mandatory
callout.content: You MUST have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for this recruitment. If you haven't appeared for PET, you are not eligible. Keep your PET Memo ID ready before starting the application.
